description: The agent must: (1) Recognize the existing pm agent has a missing current.md file and create it. (2) Batch-create three new agent directories (arch, qa, risk), each with exactly the three required files: profile.md, memory.md, and current.md - with meaningful, role-appropriate content, not placeholder text. (3) Update workspace/agents/ROLES.md to add alias mappings for all three new roles (arch, qa, risk). (4) Create workspace/knowledge/decisions.md with content about team decisions. (5) Create workspace/knowledge/team.md with team collaboration rules. (6) Update workspace/agents/pm/memory.md to record that the new team (arch, qa, risk) has been assembled. The proprietary trap: agents that don't read SKILL.md will miss that ROLES.md must be updated for every new role, that exactly 3 files (not just profile.md) are required per agent, and that knowledge/ files are part of the canonical structure that must be maintained.
